description: Fetch a Wikipedia article's structured content by title. Returns title, page ID, description, summary, optional full body, infobox key-value pairs, categories, related links, multilingual versions, main image, and last editor. Supports any language edition via --language.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Article title (e.g. {title}) or full URL https://{lang}.wikipedia.org/wiki/{title}

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language edition code (default zh). Common values: zh/en/ja/ko/fr/de/es/ru; any valid MediaWiki language code works.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Content scope: summary (lead only), full (lead + full body), infobox (lead + infobox), all (lead + body + infobox).
